info.name: TeamHub
info.summary: Team collaboration hub — Collaboration, projects, department work all build on top of Nextcloud Teams
info.description:
TeamHub is a workspace built on top of Nextcloud Teams (Circles).
**Each team gets a shared home - **Messages** — post announcements, questions and polls to your team - **Activity feed** — a single view of recent file, calendar, task and member changes across all shared resources - **App tabs** — quick-links to the team's shared Talk chat, Team folder, Calendar, Collective and Deck board - **Widgets** — upcoming calendar events, open Deck tasks, Pages, the activity snapshot and others through integrations
**Personal layer - **What's new** - One overview of all recent communication aggregated from all teams you belong to. - **My work** - One actionable overview of all items that need your attention aggregated from all teams you belong to.
**Management - **Customizable view** — users can create their own layout per team - **Team management** — team admins/owners are in control on their teams by managing the resources, members and permissions - **TeamHub management** - Nextcloud admins have their own controls to manage TeamHub under admin settings - **Bulk import/export** - Admins can bulk import teams from a CSV file
**Development - **Integrations** — developers can integrate their app with teamhub we are API driven - **Internal integrations** - Added TeamHub native integrations for Decisions, Presence, Timeline, Budget and Time
TeamHub works entirely within your Nextcloud instance and does not require any external services.
info.author: Justin Doek
